name: @chartrunner/core
description: ChartRunner core SDK — the only thing that issues orders. ChartHost / AbilityRegistry / BrokerAdapter / RiskManager / SignalFeed plus the trading primitives (bracket / ladder / OCO / hedge / radar / rescue + Tier 1-4). Framework-free; builds to an npm ESM package AND an inlinable IIFE for play/ (see docs/architecture/M25-bundler-decision.md).

scripts.test: npm run build && for f in tests/*.test.mjs; do echo "=== $f ==="; node "$f" || exit 1; done
